values.note: 2027 Campground Rates: $45 per site Sunday-Thursday nights, $50 Friday, Saturday and holidays (Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day), each for one household or up to four unrelated people; +$5 per additional person per night. Optional $10 early-arrival and $10 late-departure fees. Cancellation with 21+ days notice refunded less a $20 administration fee.

values.note: Modern bathhouse and shower rooms, coin laundry, fish-cleaning house, and a Snack Shack selling packaged snacks, ice cream and a few store items. Beach and the camp's rowboats, canoes, kayaks, paddle boats and paddle boards free first-come (shared with retreat groups; electric trolling motors only).

values.note: Reserve by phone (269-792-2081) or email; individual reservations open December 1 for the next season (2027 opens December 1, 2026) with a 50% deposit. Church groups may book up to a year ahead. 3-night minimum on Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends; the campground license caps stays at 14 days.

note: Public campground (Daisy Park) at SON-Life Camp & Retreat Center, a Christian camp at 189 126th Ave near Wayland, 30 minutes from both Grand Rapids and Kalamazoo; sites on a wooded strip along the camp's lake, with swimming at the camp waterfront until dusk (no lifeguard). Camp programs run alongside. Alcohol and marijuana are prohibited on camp property. Opens mid-May. Not on RV Life; Good Sam 7.5/5.5/7.2; Google 4.5 over 38 reviews. --Claude
summary: Camp's own campground page: 2027 rates $45 Sun-Thu / $50 Fri-Sat and holidays (fees $40-45 -> $45-50), 20 sites with water and electric (confirmed), showers/laundry/snack shack (new), phone/email booking (platform new), 3-night holiday minimum and 14-day license maximum (new). Individual families book directly ('church groups and families'), no seasonal sites, so it sells nights to the public. Base $45 is under the US$50 gate. Amperage, sewer, rig length and a closing date not stated. Phone matches. Note trimmed of field restatements and the outdated 2026 rates.
